data.title: STEP 1: HTLC Script Construction
data.comment: Build the HTLC locking script and derive the P2WSH address to fund.

data.title: STEP 2: Paste & Extract Funding TX
data.comment: Paste the raw funding tx hex. Extract txid and UTXO details.

data.title: STEP 3: Build Unsigned Spending TX
data.comment: Assemble the unsigned tx body used for BIP143 sighash computation.

data.title: STEP 4: Sign & Assemble Witness TX
data.comment: Compute BIP143 sighash, sign, build witness stack, produce final segwit tx.

data.title: STEP 5: Verify & Broadcast
data.comment: Verify the script locally. Broadcast with bitcoin-cli -testnet sendrawtransaction.

data.content:
## Step 1: Build the HTLC Locking Script

A Hash Time-Locked Contract has two unlock paths:

**Door A (Success):** Reveal the preimage that SHA256-hashes to the payment hash → Bob claims funds.

**Door B (Timeout):** Wait until the agreed block height passes → Alice reclaims funds.

👉 Keys auto-generate. Enter a preimage hex (e.g. `68656c6c6f`) and a future block height (e.g. `900000`).

Watch the opcodes and push-data nodes assemble the full locking script.

The SHA256 of that script becomes the P2WSH address — fund it on testnet3.
data.title: Text Info Node

data.content:
## Step 2: Paste Your Funding TX

After sending funds to the P2WSH address from Step 1, paste the raw transaction hex here.

👉 Get it from a testnet explorer or:
`bitcoin-cli -testnet getrawtransaction <txid>`

The nodes extract:
- **txid** → reversed for the spending tx input
- **vout.value** → the UTXO amount
- **vout.scriptPubKey** → the P2WSH output script
data.title: Text Info Node

data.content:
## Step 3: Assemble the Unsigned Spending TX

Build the base transaction body (no witness yet). This structure is used to compute the BIP143 sighash in Step 4.

👉 Paste a testnet recipient address.
👉 Enter output amount in satoshis (leave room for fees).

The scriptSig is empty (`00`) — P2WSH moves all data to the witness.

The output = amount (8 bytes LE) + scriptPubKey length varint + scriptPubKey.
data.title: Text Info Node

data.content:
## Step 4: BIP143 Sighash + Sign + Witness

**BIP143** is the SegWit sighash algorithm. It hashes specific components, fixing quadratic hashing and tx malleability.

Components:
- **hashPrevouts**: DSHA256(outpoint)
- **hashSequence**: DSHA256(sequence)
- **hashOutputs**: DSHA256(outputs)
- **scriptCode**: varint(len) + witness script

Preimage → DSHA256 → sighash → signed with Bob's key.

**Witness stack** (success path):
`count | sig | preimage | OP_TRUE | witness_script`

Each item has a varint length prefix. Final segwit tx uses `0001` marker after version.
data.title: Text Info Node

data.content:
## Step 5: Verify & Broadcast

Local script verification proves correctness before broadcasting.

If result shows **TRUE** — script executes correctly.

**To broadcast:**
`bitcoin-cli -testnet sendrawtransaction <hex>`

Broadcast may fail if:
- UTXO already spent
- CLTV locktime not reached (timeout path)
- Relay policy rejects non-standard scripts

The extracted txid is the final malleability-fixed transaction ID.
data.title: Text Info Node
